facts.statement: SOE Podcast 84 was released to celebrate Free Realms' first birthday and included a lot of Free Realms discussion alongside other SOE gaming news.
facts.quote: a lot of Free Realms talk in honor of the game's first birthday

article_summaries.title: SOE Podcast 84 - Happy Birthday Free Realms!
article_summaries.summary: Ten Ton Hammer's post announces SOE Podcast 84, posted April 27, 2010, which devotes a substantial share of its content to Free Realms in honor of the game's first birthday. The text gives only the show's format and host lineup, with no details of the Free Realms content discussed, so it adds little to the rebuild beyond confirming the anniversary timing.
